runtime_control.default_speed: 12000ms base + 0-6000ms jitter (大量任务 / 更稳)
runtime_control.pause_semantics: explicit user pause never auto-resumes; shared backend scheduler starts no new ChatHarbor control request while paused
runtime_control.cancel_semantics: stop at safe boundary; completed per-conversation commits remain authoritative
runtime_control.sleep_semantics: conservative waits use absolute Date.now() deadlines; elapsed OS sleep counts; wake adds normal request jitter
runtime_control.remote_index_cache: IndexedDB; disposable acceleration data; complete snapshots authoritative for absence checks; incomplete snapshots may persist for UI/recovery only
runtime_control.network_scheduler: single serialized ChatHarbor /backend-api control gate with lane-aware cadence: discovery 1.0-1.5s, detail use-case preset cadence/batching, attachment metadata 3-5s plus 10-request/30-60s micro-batch; shared retry taxonomy and 429 cooldown
runtime_control.global_429_cooldown: 300s × retry attempt (5 min first retry, 10 min second), shared across discovery/detail/attachment paths; each 429 increases detail/attachment cadence by 50% for the current page, capped at level 4
runtime_control.binary_transfer: separate data-transfer retry path; no ordinary control-plane pacing, but 429 advances global cooldown
runtime_control.http_failure_policy: 429 global cooldown + adaptive slowdown; 5xx lane-specific bounded retry; 401/403/404 no blind retry; transport failures lane-specific retry

ui.launcher: 44px green, right-edge default at 45% viewport height, half-hidden when idle, position persisted
ui.reporting: preflight details folded into local archive card; sync completion inline; copyable detailed reports; no dedicated report modal
ui.selection: single explicit selected conversation-id set; tri-state select-all applies to full filtered result; counts stay left at a fixed offset as Selected N · Current M / Total T when filtered
ui.directory_flow: restore last save location when browser permission allows; choose/change directory is the only picker action; re-check scans the current location; sync never opens the directory picker
ui.remote_scope_cache: persistent Remote Index can render immediately; background head validation; changed head/full-expiry falls back to full refresh; Team remains a separate identity/cache
ui.archive_summary: plain user summary: 已保存 / 已同步 / 待同步 / 需确认 / 异常; technical status breakdown moves to details
ui.header_context: provider only; scope remains in filter controls and archive directory remains in Local archive card
ui.run_settings: request-speed preset and attachment choice are visible but immutable during an active sync; advanced numeric pacing is nested under 高级设置
ui.refresh: normal click = fast newest-window validation; Shift+click = force complete refresh
ui.preflight_status_visibility: main UI maps fine-grained internal states to four user states: 已同步 / 待同步 / 需确认 / 异常
ui.progress: stable 会话进度 X / Y for actual runtime work; current conversation/sub-task shown separately; transient waits never replace the main progress
ui.tooltips: short plain-language hints only where action meaning is not already obvious
